anomalies.observed: Q2 is specified as NTR2101P in the schematic and is used as a high-side switch: its source is on +3V3, its drain feeds Display_Power_Switch, and its gate is driven by U5.31 with R2 pulling it up to +3V3. NTR2101P is an N-channel MOSFET, not a P-channel MOSFET.
anomalies.expected: A P-channel MOSFET suitable for high-side switching, as intended by the specification, so the GPIO can control the EPD power rail.

evidence.quote: Q2 NTR2101P; R2 10k to +3V3; Q2 output labelled Display_Power_Switch (SkylabModule.kicad_sch, page 2/4).
Display_Power_Switch connects to J1 pins 15 and 16 (EPD_Driver.kicad_sch, page 3/4).
Q2 | NTR2101P (P-channel MOSFET, SOT-23) | High-side load switch for EPD VDD/VDDIO rail.

anomalies.impact: With the specified N-channel device in this P-channel high-side topology, the GPIO cannot switch the rail on as intended; its body diode may instead partially power the display when the switch is meant to be off.

parsed.summary: Q2 is identified as NTR2101P, an N-channel part, but the schematic uses it as a P-channel high-side EPD power switch. This component-type mismatch prevents the display rail from being controlled as intended.
